title: Add moeb signal add command for direct signal injection
description: Signals can currently only be created by AI agents at run end. There is no command-line mechanism to inject a signal directly — for example, to record a known issue, a feature request, or a batch of observations from a planning session. This planning session itself required manual JSON file authoring to create signals.
proposed_resolution: Implement moeb signal add accepting: --title, --description, --category, and --severity flags. Severity defaults by category: feature → Minor, fix → Major, error → Critical. A --batch flag accepts a JSON file containing an array of signal objects. Each signal is written to the catalogue with a generated signal_id, current timestamp, and occurrence_count: 1. The command prints the signal_id of each created signal.
